NOTICE OF NEW HEARING DATE AND ORDER ON REISSUANCE (ELDER OR DEPENDENT ADULT ABUSE)
Off Calendar Mar-07-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: All Parties sworn prior to commencement of the proceeding.

Appearances: Kathryn Reed (Petitioner). Adrian Derenzy (Respondent).

The Court hears testimony, receives evidence and after hearing the evidence presented, the Petitioner qualified as a Dependent Adult and the Court will grant a protective order with respect to Adrian Derenzy. Petitioner's order is Granted as follows: Respondent shall stay at least 100 yards away from the protected person and the home.

Respondent shall not Physically Abuse, Financially Abuse, Intimidate, Molest, Attack, Strike, Stalk, Threaten, Assault (sexually or otherwise), Hit, Harass, Destroy the Personal Property of, or Disturb the peace of the Person. The Stay Away Order includes a vehicle or a workplace.

No Guns or Other Firearms/Turn In or Sell Guns or Firearms.

Expires three years from the date of issuance of this order (March 7, 2015).

Judge: Peter Busch. Court Reporter: Louis Gillian CSR #12355. Clerk: Rosie Noguera/Ella Yip. Bailiff: Deputy M. Meddoza.
